caption: Four landmarks in order with the years between them. The 24-year gap between the 1968 tracked display and the 1992 CAVE is the widest.

spec.title: Four VR landmarks
spec.aria: A left-to-right chain of four VR landmarks: Sensorama 1962, tracked head-mounted display 1968, CAVE 1992 and the Rift campaign 2012, with arrows labelled 6, 24 and 20 years; the 24-year arrow is highlighted.
